names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 ianuarie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Xenia din Sankt Petersburg».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Ιανουαρίου, «Οσία Ξένη η Διά Χριστόν Σαλή», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfânta Xenia a adormit în Domnul la vârsta de șaptezeci și unu de ani (între 1794 și 1806)». The page gives no single year, so the interval is the one it prints.

hymns.text: Iubind sărăcia lui Hristos, acum te îndulcești de ospățul cel veșnic; cu nebunia cea părută ai rușinat nebunia acestei lumi, prin smerenia Crucii ai primit puterea lui Dumnezeu. Pentru aceasta, dobândind darul ajutorării prin minuni, fericită Xenia, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să ne izbăvească prin pocăință de tot răul.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Cuvioase Xenia din Sankt Petersburg, Glas 7

english.text: Loving the poverty of Christ, thou now delightest in the everlasting banquet; with feigned madness thou didst shame the madness of this world, and through the humility of the Cross thou didst receive the power of God. Wherefore, having been given the gift of helping by wonders, blessed Xenia, pray to Christ God to deliver us from every evil through repentance.

hymns.text: Luminat saltă astăzi cetatea lui Petru, că mulțimea celor scârbiți află mângâieri, nădăjduind la rugăciunile tale, fericită Xenia, că tu ești lauda și întărirea acestei cetăți

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfintei Cuvioase Xenia din Sankt Petersburg, Glas 3. The page's text ends without a final stop, and is copied as it stands.

english.text: Brightly does the city of Peter leap up today, for the multitude of the afflicted find their consolation, hoping in thy prayers, blessed Xenia; for thou art the praise and the strength of this city

hymns.text: Σ’ ἐσένα, ὢ περιπλαμένη ξένη, Χριστὸς ὁ Κύριος μας ἔδωσε μιὰ διακαὴ μεσίτρια γιὰ ὅλους μας. Ἔχοντας λάβει στὴ ζωή σου βάσανα καὶ θλίψη , καὶ ὑπηρετώντας τὸ Θεὸ καὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους μὲ ἀγάπη, ἐσὺ ἀπέκτησες μεγάλη παρρησία στὸ Θεό. Δὶ’ αὐτό, σπεύδουμε θερμὰ σ’ ἐσένα στοὺς πειρασμοὺς καὶ τὴ θλίψη, κραυγάζοντας ἐκ βάθους ψυχῆς : Μὴν ἐγκαταλείψεις τὴν ἐλπίδα μας στὴν καταισχύνη, ὢ εὐλογημένη Ξένια.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, on the page of Οσία Ξένη η Διά Χριστόν Σαλή. The text is printed in modern Greek, not in the liturgical idiom, and reads as a rendering of the Russian service; it is copied here exactly as the page has it.

english.text: In thee, O wandering stranger, Christ our Lord has given us a fervent intercessor for us all. Having received in thy life torment and affliction, and having served God and men with love, thou didst gain great boldness before God. Therefore we hasten warmly to thee in temptations and in affliction, crying from the depth of the soul: do not leave our hope to be put to shame, O blessed Xenia.

hymns.text: Περιπλανώμενη ξένη σὲ μιὰ ξένη γῆ, ἀναστενάζοντας πάντα γιὰ τὴ οὐράνια πατρίδα γνωστὴ ὡς σαλὴ καὶ ἄπιστη ἀλλὰ γιὰ τοὺς πιστοὺς πολὺ σοφὴ καὶ ἱερὴ , στεφανωμένη ἀπὸ τὸ Θεὸ μὲ δόξα καὶ τιμή. Ὢ Ξένια, γενναία στὸ μυαλὸ καὶ θεϊκὰ σοφή. Δι’αυτό, κραυγάζουμε σὲ σένα «Χαῖρε ἐσὺ ποὺ μετὰ τὴ γήινη περιπλάνησή σου ἦρθες καὶ κατοικεῖς στὸ οἶκο τοῦ Θεοῦ».

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, on the page of Οσία Ξένη η Διά Χριστόν Σαλή. Printed in modern Greek, like the apolytikion above it, and copied exactly as the page has it.

english.text: A stranger wandering in a strange land, always sighing for the heavenly homeland, known as a fool and faithless, but to the faithful most wise and holy, crowned by God with glory and honour: O Xenia, brave in mind and divinely wise. Therefore we cry to thee: Rejoice, thou who after thy earthly wandering hast come to dwell in the house of God.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 ianuarie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Xenia din Sankt Petersburg»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Ιανουαρίου — «Οσία Ξένη η Διά Χριστόν Σαλή»

attestations.note: The same day page carries a second and separate line, «Οσίες Ξένη και οι δύο θεραπαινίδες της», which is the fifth-century Xenia of Rome on her own page; the two are not one woman and the calendar does not join them.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
